description: Recent payments you received on your Endpoints, Products, payment links and invoices, newest first, with filters. Needs an access token with mcp:read. Endpoints cover the latest 50 each.

accessToken.description: Your Studio access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

min_amount.description: Only payments of at least this amount

payer.description: Only payments from this wallet address

product.description: Only this Product or payment link (id or slug)

since.description: Only payments at or after this date (ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-01)

source.description: all (default), endpoints, or products (Products, payment links and invoices)

status.description: Only this status, for example confirmed

name: list_payments
